This article compares the distribution of the [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients who have experienced an [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five regions. The data highlights the thromboembolic risk profile of patients who suffered a severe bleeding event, demonstrating that a majority of these patients had a moderate risk score prior to or at the time of the event.

Across [[danmark|Danmark]], the most prevalent CHA2DS2-VASc scores were 1 and 2, which together accounted for 70.0% of the patient population [^src1]. Specifically, a score of 1 was the most common, recorded in 261 patients (36.7%), followed closely by a score of 2 in 237 patients (33.3%) [^src1]. This indicates that even patients with a moderate thromboembolic risk are susceptible to severe intracranial bleeding [^src1]. In [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], a score of 1 was also the most frequent (51 patients, 31.9%), mirroring the national trend [^src1].

Conversely, the highest risk categories were the least represented. A score of 5 was the rarest, observed in only 4 patients (0.6%) nationally [^src1]. In several regions, including [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]], the count for a score of 5 was exactly zero, while other regions reported suppressed or negligible numbers (marked as "#") [^src1]. A score of 0 was also relatively uncommon, representing 50 patients (7.0%) nationwide, with regional counts ranging from 5 in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] to 17 in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] [^src1]. 

Because this comparison is based on a single dated section, no longitudinal trends can be established regarding how these distributions may have shifted over time.

Summary: Tabellen viser, at de fleste prævalente atrieflimren-patienter med intrakraniel blødning har en CHA2DS2-VASc-score på 1 eller 2 (70 % tilsammen), hvilket indikerer, at selv patienter med moderat tromboembolisk risiko er udsat for alvorlig blødning.
